thread:
incident-bot: [ALERT] prod-infer-4: multiple containers restarting on GPU nodes (OOM during prefill). Error rate and p95 latency rising. Paging oncall @carol_oncall :rotating_light:

alice_sre: ack — I'm watching. Any immediate customer impact?

carol_oncall: I'm on it. Pulling kube logs and runtime traces. Which nodes are noisy?

ben_runtime: nodes: node-az3-gpu12, node-az3-gpu13. Root cause looks like prefill OOM when sequence length > ~60k tokens. Also seeing CUDA errors and container restart loop. Sample log:```
2026-03-17T04:20:10Z runtime ERROR: prefilling tokens 0..62000 -> allocation failure
2026-03-17T04:20:11Z cuda ERROR: cuMemAlloc failed: out of memory
2026-03-17T04:20:11Z container INFO: exiting with code 137 (OOM)
```

dave_support: we've got a handful of customer reports: chat timeouts and partial streams for two enterprise tenants. They noticed after submitting very long context uploads.

elaine_pm: need a short customer note. Can we estimate ETA for mitigation?

maria_custops: suggest: "We're investigating elevated inference errors for long-context requests. We're actively mitigating and will update within 30m."

carol_oncall: mitigation plan (short):
- throttle/trim incoming prefill lengths at edge to 8k tokens for affected routes
- route large requests to fallback pool with smaller model variant (redwood-medium)
- enable aggressive kvcache eviction + reduce batch_size on prod-infer-4
- isolate noisy nodes and restart runtime pods

ben_runtime: I'll push the runtime flags and patch the routing config now. Commands:```
# set env to cap prefill
kubectl patch configmap routing-config -n prod --type merge -p '{"data":{"PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS":"8000"}}'
# reduce default batch size
kubectl set env deployment/runtime -n prod BATCH_SIZE=8
# enable stronger kv-eviction
kubectl exec -n prod runtime-pod -- curl -X POST http://localhost:8080/_admin/cache?eviction=aggressive
```

alice_sre: I'll cordon node-az3-gpu12/13 and drain pods to move workload off.```
kubectl cordon node-az3-gpu12
kubectl drain node-az3-gpu12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force
```
I'll also flip the routing fallback to the dedicated fallback pool to reduce load on the cluster.

carol_oncall: doing live runbook steps now. Will post when routing change has propagated. Heads-up: rolling restarts may temporarily increase latency for in-flight sessions.

incident-bot: [UPDATE] mitigation actions applied: PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS=8000 applied to routing-config; batch_size reduced; KV eviction: aggressive. Monitoring for 15m.

dave_support: posting customer update based on maria_custops suggestion. Sent to affected tenants (two customers) with link to status page.

ben_runtime: after patches, error rate on those nodes dropped ~85%. Still seeing one crash on node-az3-gpu13; I'm tailing logs.

alice_sre: node-az3-gpu13 had a stuck process owning GPU memory. I restarted the host runtime service and cordoned it for further investigation. Uncordoning when stable.

carol_oncall: status: latency and error rates trending back to normal. Customer impact reduced. Leaving noisy node cordoned until postmortem. Handing off to night oncall in 30m — please add any follow-ups to incident doc.

incident-bot: Reminder: open an incident ticket and assign owners for post-incident review (runtime, serving, custops).

maria_custops: will follow-up with customers after postmortem.

elaine_pm: thanks team. Please log exact timeline and config diffs for the RCA. :thumbsup:
summary: GPU OOM during prefill on prod-infer-4 caused container restarts; oncall patched PREFILL_MAX_TOKENS, reduced batch size, enabled aggressive kv eviction, cordoned noisy nodes, and routed to fallback model pool. Customer updates sent; follow-up/postmortem requested.
